COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Network Troubleshooting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Troubleshooting.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Troubleshooting.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Troubleshooting.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Network Troubleshooting.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

4. When learning Emerging Technologies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Technologies.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Technologies.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Technologies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Technologies.

5. When learning Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.

6. When learning Cybersecurity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Cybersecurity.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cybersecurity.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cybersecurity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cybersecurity.

7. When learning Social and Ethical Issues in Networking, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

9. When learning Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.

10. When learning Data Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Structures.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Structures.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Structures.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Structures.

11. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.

12. When learning Data Analysis and Visualisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Analysis and Visualisation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Data Analysis and Visualisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Career Opportunities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
